o.text: Internationalism; ultimately from Latin professor (“declarer, person who claims knowledge”).
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *kïŕïl, a derivation from Proto-Turkic *kï̄ŕ-. Related to Azerbaijani qızmaq (“to heat up”).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish كون (gön), from Proto-Common Turkic *kȫn (“tanned skin, leather”).
Borrowed from Russian салфетка (salfetka), ultimately from French serviette.
